info.description: Go Echo API for AI LLM operation management, agent registry management, CPU/GPU VM placement, and AI application deployment-control planning.
info.title: AI-Ops Service Control API

get.description: Return the configured bounded-action agent registry.

post.description: Register an external agent endpoint, capabilities, and bounded actions in process memory.
post.summary: Register an external AI operation agent

get.summary: Get a registered AI operation agent

delete.description: Delete only an Agent registered in process memory. Configuration-backed Agents are protected.
delete.summary: Delete a runtime AI operation agent

post.summary: Validate an action against an agent boundary

post.description: Validate the registered capability and bounded action, then return a non-executing invocation plan.
post.summary: Build a validated external-agent invocation plan

post.description: Build a non-executing, capability-based handoff plan for any registered external execution agent.
post.summary: Build an AI application deployment plan

post.description: Validate whether an infrastructure-supplied VM snapshot satisfies declared workload requirements without selecting or provisioning a VM.
Call an actual configured LLM candidate, validate its bounded Action against actual VM evidence and Agent Registry policy, and return a non-executing external-agent handoff.
post.summary: Generate and validate an LLM-based automation Action

get.description: Return normalized execution feedback records held by the current geon process, newest first.

post.description: Record normalized status and optional performance evidence for a previously approved correlation ID. Credentials and arbitrary secret fields are not accepted.

delete.description: Clear geon-owned feedback records while preserving approved correlation registrations.
Delete one geon-owned feedback record while preserving its approved correlation registration.
delete.summary: Delete one automation execution feedback record

delete.description: Clear only the in-memory event timeline. Loop configuration, runtime state, cooldown, and Action budget are preserved.
Delete one in-memory timeline event by its monotonic sequence. Later events keep their original sequence values.
delete.summary: Delete one guarded autonomous loop event

post.description: Create a backend ControlRun, validate the request and Agent Registry authorization, invoke the configured Qwen Planner, and return a Go-validated DeploymentManifest without requiring AppDeploy.

delete.description: Clear only the in-memory geon ControlRun store. This does not delete AppDeploy or cloud resources.
Delete only the in-memory geon ControlRun. This does not delete AppDeploy or cloud resources.

post.description: Revalidate the selected Agent submit permission and send the approved DeploymentManifest to AppDeploy. AppDeploy retains final Target selection and execution responsibility.
post.summary: Submit an approved ControlRun Manifest to AppDeploy

post.description: Rank Ops LLM candidates using the configured service-control benchmark policy.
post.summary: Select an Ops LLM policy candidate

post.description: Validate the request with Go Request Guard, use an actual configured LLM to generate an AppDeploy DeploymentManifest, validate it with Go Manifest Guard, submit it to AppDeploy, and poll the deployment status. AppDeploy retains target selection and execution responsibility.
post.summary: Plan and submit an AI application deployment

post.description: Execute the Go service-control flow across LLM selection, agent checks, actual VM suitability validation, and generic deployment-control handoff planning.

get.description: Return a lightweight readiness response for the Go service-control API.
Return the submission OpenAPI YAML for the service-control prototype.
